title: Find the count of unique artists who illustrated cards that are (a) legal i
question: Find the count of unique artists who illustrated cards that are (a) legal in the Legacy format, (b) have a converted mana cost of 3, (c) belong to sets whose name contains 'World Championship', and (d) are not considered 'powerful foils' (i.e., either cardKingdomId or cardKingdomFoilId is NULL).

prediction.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."XCL_002")
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_086"
INNER JOIN sets AS T3 ON T1."XCL_063" = T3."XCL_099"
WHERE T2."XCL_084" = 'legacy'
  AND T2."XCL_085" = 'Legal'
  AND T1."XCL_011" = 3
  AND T3."XCL_110" LIKE '%World Championship%'
  AND (T1."XCL_007" IS NULL OR T1."XCL_006" IS NULL)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."XCL_002")
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T1."XCL_063" = T2."XCL_099"
INNER JOIN legalities AS T3 ON T1."XCL_072" = T3."XCL_086"
WHERE T3."XCL_084" = 'legacy'
  AND T3."XCL_085" = 'Legal'
  AND T1."XCL_011" = 3
  AND T2."XCL_110" LIKE '%World Championship%'
  AND (T1."XCL_001" IS NULL OR T1."XCL_004" IS NULL)
